scope: Read-only Colab packaging/orchestration review plus pure CPU toy snapshot and AST contracts. No Colab cell, upload, resource configuration, GPU or model call executed.

resolved_findings.issue: Concurrent report writes could make STATUS JSON parsing fail and cancel a backup.
resolved_findings.resolution: Training JSON writes now atomic. Snapshot reads each selected file once, archives raw bytes even when JSON parsing fails, and derives progress from the same captured bytes.
resolved_findings.cpu_coverage: Malformed training-report prefix preserved; no repeated reads.

resolved_findings.issue: Missing/corrupt final weights were silently skipped while a saved-weights download was still advertised.
resolved_findings.resolution: Four known smoke/formal initial/final weight paths are inventoried with expected/actual SHA and verified/missing/unverified states. Unverified known weight bytes are retained and completion is false.
resolved_findings.cpu_coverage: Matching full inventory; missing/corrupt initial and final; journals and all failed task outcomes retained.

resolved_findings.issue: Launch marker exists-check followed by atomic replacement could clobber a racing launch provenance.
resolved_findings.resolution: cloud_run now reserves its first marker with exclusive creation, flush/fsync; later phase updates remain atomic. Fixed smoke4/fresh1344/CPUproof/validation48+test144 scope and no retry remain.

resolved_findings.issue: Source name filter admitted nested env/database/key paths; backup paths could follow symlinks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Bundle rejects nested .env/git/ssh/aws and database/key/weight containers; project reads reject symlinks and outside boundaries. Snapshot opens each ancestor with no-follow directory FDs, reads only bounded regular files, excludes secrets/DB/base and unknown weights.

complete_artifacts_presence_requires: training proof and sealed identity hash bindings
complete unique ordered validation48 and three-arm test144
all corresponding journal entries completed and matched to trace
protocol rows and three input metadata files present
snapshot_contract.limitation: This is structural backup inventory, not tensor/value/tokenizer/business/consent or model-quality verification. Actual source/weight packages are built and checked only after seal.
